subject: PO metadata, invoice cadence and payment window for StrataCloud engagement

Subject: PO requirements & invoice cadence for Redwood pilot

Hi Jasmine,

Quick note from procurement as we're preparing the PO for the pilot engagement. A few mandatory fields and cadence items your finance team needs to confirm so we can route internally: 

- PO must reference our internal project code (SC-PROJ-8421) and include a line for "Vendor Service SOW ID".
- Payment terms requested: net60 standard. Procurement will only sign net60 for vendors without an approved supplier credit line.
- Invoices should be sent monthly and reference a single PO number. If you can only issue multiple invoices, we need each invoice to include the PO number and the GL mapping.
- We prefer consolidated monthly statements for reconciliation; ability to accept statement-level remittance is helpful.
- Required invoice fields: PO#, invoice number, invoice date, GL code, cost center, and tax breakdown.

Can you confirm Redwood can produce an invoice that includes all of the above? Also please share a sample invoice so we can validate our ERP upload.

Thanks,
Alex
Alex Mason
Head of Procurement | StrataCloud

Attaching a draft SOW and a sample invoice format to validate with your ERP.

Hi Alex — looping in Sales Ops and Finance for the mapping details. A few practical notes from our side: 

Operational options we support:
1) Standard: Monthly invoice per PO (one invoice per PO per month). Each invoice will contain a dedicated field for PO#, and a free-text "Customer GL/Cost Center" field.
2) Consolidated statement: We can produce a consolidated monthly statement (single PDF) that lists multiple Redwood invoice numbers and the associated PO numbers. Important: your AP team must accept statement-level remittance where individual invoice numbers are visible; otherwise the ERP auto-match may fail.
3) Split invoices: We can issue up to 3 split invoices per month against a single PO (if different business units require separate GL codes).

Compliance & IDs:
- Please include your PO in the DocuSign envelope title and body.
- Use customer-provided GL codes where possible — our ERP will store them as a free-text field for upload. If StrataCloud requires a fixed mapping (e.g., only a numeric GL), please send a sample extract.

Payment terms negotiation suggestion:
- For an initial pilot we recommend net45 (fast activation). For enterprise rollouts we accept net60 but require either a signed commitment letter or inclusion of your procurement SLA clause referencing vendor credit approval. Alternatively, if StrataCloud needs strict net60, we can offer a 1% early-pay discount for payments within 30 days.

DocuSign link for the SOW: https://www.docusign.com/link/xyz-activation (please add PO# in envelope).

Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
On Wed, Sep 9, 2026 at 16:41 Alex Mason <alex.mason@stratacloud.com> wrote:
> Thanks Jasmine & Vanessa — helpful. A few follow-ups from procurement: 
> 
> - Consolidated statement is preferable because our ERP only creates one payable batch per month. If the statement lists each Redwood invoice number and the associated PO, our system can accept it.
> - Net45 on pilot is acceptable, but procurement will need an internal approval ticket to move to net60 after go-live (we generally require a supplier risk review). Can Redwood accept a conditional net45 -> net60 transition clause in the SOW?
> - We will send a sample CSV extract by end of day so you can confirm field names.
> 
> One more ask: our tax team wants to confirm Redwood's vendor registration ID and whether Redwood can apply VAT reverse-charge where applicable (we are US-based but have european subsidiaries). Who on your side is the VAT/contact?
> 
> Thanks,
> Alex

Alex —

Appreciate the quick responses and the CSV sample when you have it. Confirming the approach so procurement can issue the PO: 

- Redwood accepts a conditional clause in the SOW: net45 for the 90-day pilot, auto-transitioning to net60 after completion upon receipt of procurement approval. We'll include the conditional transition language in the SOW draft (attached).
- We can produce a consolidated monthly statement that lists each Redwood invoice number and associated PO number (this satisfies your ERP batch). Please note: when you accept consolidated statements, your AP team must still reference invoice numbers during payment; otherwise auto-match can fail.
- For VAT/reverse-charge: our finance team (cc Vivek) will confirm Redwood's VAT handling. Vivek — can you provide vendor registration ID and guidance on reverse-charge applicability?

Next steps:
1) StrataCloud to send sample ERP CSV mapping (procurement).
2) Procurement to issue PO that references SC-PROJ-8421 and includes the SOW title in the DocuSign envelope.
3) Redwood to return a SOW with the conditional net45->net60 clause and the sample invoice format we attached.

If that looks good I'll send a final SOW for signature today.

Best,
